title: Probability and statistics
summary: Reading graphs, frequency tables, mean, median, mode, range, sampling, probability, two-step experiments, tree diagrams, Venn diagrams and experimental probability.

cards.title: Interpreting graphs and tables
cards.rule: Read the title, the axes, the scale and the key first.
lines: Column graphs for categories, line graphs for change over time, pie charts for parts of a whole

cards.title: Frequency tables
cards.rule: Tally each result, then count. Frequency is how many times it happened.

cards.title: Graphs of frequency tables
cards.rule: Histograms show numerical data: the columns touch.
lines: Also: dot plots, and stem-and-leaf plots (key 2 | 4 = 24)

cards.title: Measures of centre
cards.rule: Mean: add and divide. Median: middle value in order. Mode: most common.

cards.title: Measures of spread
cards.rule: Range = max − min. IQR \(= Q_3 - Q_1\), the spread of the middle half.
cards.note: Split the data in half at the median, then find the median of each half.

cards.title: Surveying and sampling
cards.rule: A sample should represent the population. Random samples avoid bias.
lines: Asking only your friends isn't a random sample

cards.title: Two-step experiments
cards.rule: List every outcome in a table.
lines: Two coins: HH, HT, TH, TT. \(P(\text{one head}) = \tfrac24 = \tfrac12\)

cards.title: Tree diagrams
cards.rule: Multiply along the branches, then add the results you want.
lines: 3 red and 1 blue, with replacement: \(P(\text{red, red}) = \tfrac34 \times \tfrac34 = \tfrac{9}{16}\)

fig.alt: Venn diagram: 10 in A only, 4 in both, 6 in B only, 5 in neither

cards.title: Experimental probability
cards.rule: Relative frequency \(= \dfrac{\text{times it happened}}{\text{number of trials}}\)
lines: 18 heads in 50 tosses: \(\tfrac{18}{50} = 0.36\). The expected probability is 0.5.
More trials usually get closer to the expected probability.
